problem: Work, notes, to-dos and meetings are scattered across tools. Mindmesh pitched a single virtual desk to centralize them.

founders.name: Raffaele Colella
prior_employers: Google (lead PM on Google News app)
previous_startups: First startup built two apps, one an Apple Best New App, acqui-hired by Google (per YC page)

founders.name: Ulysse Mizrahi
education: University of Cambridge and Ecole polytechnique, master's degrees in mathematics and theoretical physics
previous_startups: Spot (co-founder and CTO, per YC page)

technical_complexity.rationale: A notes, tasks and meetings aggregation workspace is standard web engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Crowded category of workspace tools with low switching costs; no sourced moat.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source documents an incumbent response; the company is listed Inactive.

market_need_then: Remote work in 2021 raised tool sprawl, but no sourced demand evidence for this product specifically.

branding.domain_note: Uses mindmesh.com (fetch returned empty); many later unrelated products share the name.

identity.voice_and_tone: Tagline: the virtual desk that puts you in control

branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt launch listed April 2022; no evidence of community.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name shared with several unrelated products and no sourced brand assets.

outcome_analysis: Mindmesh joined YC in Summer 2021 with a virtual desk product for knowledge workers and both founders are listed as former founders. Sources conflict: CB Insights says it was acquired by Nabors in January 2023, while a dead-startup archive says it wound down in 2023. No post-mortem or announcement was found, so the cause is not public.
notes: CB Insights reports about $2.6M over 4 rounds with investors Nabors Industries, Top Harvest Capital, Y Combinator and Entrepreneurs First, but gives no per-round dates or amounts, so no round is recorded; the funding gap is the full $2.6M. Exit left unknown because the Nabors acquisition rests on one database and looks inconsistent. The archive site mentions a pivot to Mindmesh Customer Insights that was not confirmed. Competitor searches returned only undated or unrelated pages.
